labels.audit: disagree with 'closed' as the dispatch defined it (major); implication sound
labels.note: The BTZ half (e0SingManifold_/e0Manifold_isFutureDistinguishing) is fine. The BTZ~ half, isFutureDistinguishing_of_natGloballyHyperbolic, is the ruled implication (natural GH ⇒ FD for d.causality), and it was proved at WP-46c. WP-46c's audit and REPORT held one question for WP-46d: does the hypothesis 'M̃ naturally GH' have an instance with BTZ points? The dispatch says the certificates 'span GX.BTZ.Manifolds and this file'. WP-46d gives an instance only when sing M = ∅. That is a conditional theorem (natGloballyHyperbolic_of_base_of_sing_eq_empty), and no concrete M is built. In that case M̃ has no BTZ point, so the BTZ~-specific content is not exercised. Every instance with sing M ≠ ∅, including exists_btzTildeData_natGloballyHyperbolic, goes through the tagged sorry. The hypothesis is not shown unsatisfiable: the model content isClosed_btzDevLe/isCompact_btzBox makes it plausible. So the issue is not vacuity. The row's closing condition is simply unmet. REPORT discloses this and asks the master.

dispatch_check: The dispatch asked for DEC-118 (b), 'M GH ⇒ M̃ GH' in the natural topology, via a finite-sheet lemma and a BTZ-sheet limit step, and then full certification of both rows. Delivered with 0 sorry: (i) the abstract lifting theorem isCompact_of_liftLocalData. I read it in full. It is sound: centres label the chain steps, two steps over one centre merge by causal convexity, shapes are finite, and fixed-shape chains pass to the limit by ultrafilters. It needs no finite-sheet count, which is a genuine improvement on the dispatched route. (ii) Its instantiation to M̃ (isCompact_natDiamond_of_liftLocalData). (iii) Local data over reg M for every J (liftLocalData_reg). (iv) The model half of the BTZ-sheet limit step (isClosed_btzDevLe, isCompact_btzBox, BtzDevLe.thetaFree). Not delivered: the BTZ-sheet transfer liftLocalData_sing (tagged sorry), and with it the headline natGloballyHyperbolic_of_base.

issues.where: GX.BTZTildeData.liftLocalData_sing (l.924), and the consumers natGloballyHyperbolic_of_base, exists_btzTildeData_natGloballyHyperbolic
issues.problem: The package's headline theorem, DEC-118 (b) 'M GH ⇒ M̃ naturally GH', rests on a tagged sorry. For an ARBITRARY BTZTildeData the obstruction in SCOPE (c) is credible. IsLocallyBTZTilde (VirtTame l.1310) pins T' at each lift e of a singular m only through an existential chart, one per lift, so no single W lies in all of them. The non-vacuity theorem exists_btzTildeData_natGloballyHyperbolic does not need arbitrary data, though. It needs one datum, and BTZTildeData.nonempty builds that datum from btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying_reg, whose T' is chartwise for every descending chart (hch). SCOPE (c) itself says that for such a datum 'the uniform charts are T'-charts'. It lists the remaining glue (an 𝔼₀-box whose causal hull lies in the chart, isCompact_btzBox, isClosed_btzDevLe, the segment link) and says 'Not done here'. The model parts of that glue are already proved. So the sorry on the existential, which is what the _manifolds row needs, is avoidable and was not seriously attempted.
issues.fix: State and prove liftLocalData_sing, and so natGloballyHyperbolic_of_base, for the chartwise datum. Either take hch as a hypothesis or add a BTZTildeData.chartwise variant of nonempty that returns it. Then exists_btzTildeData_natGloballyHyperbolic closes with 0 sorry. Keep the arbitrary-datum version as a tagged sorry with the SCOPE (c) obstruction, or drop it.

statement_fidelity: Every Lean statement here takes the paper's or ruled hypotheses only: IsBTZSingModelled M plus GH of e0ManifoldCausality (DEC-33), and natural GH under DEC-106/DEC-118. Nothing is added. LiftLocalData is not trivialising: it asks for ultrafilter convergence and closedness of ≤ on every component of p⁻¹(W). liftLocalData_reg discharges it substantively, through sheets of an evenly covered ψ⁻¹(ball), D = g·ψ∘p, and segment links. The hypotheses of isCompact_of_liftLocalData (strong causality, compact base diamond, monotone paths, continuity of p) are all discharged in isCompact_natDiamond_of_liftLocalData from existing library facts, with no hidden conclusion. BtzDevLe is exactly btzJ_le_iff transported (btzDevM_le_iff), and isClosed_btzDevLe is proved in the natural product topology of 𝔻∞×ℝ, where btzDevM is discontinuous at the apex. DEC-55 does not apply here. No circular use: no certifying decl depends on sorryAx.

Is DEC-118 (b) meant for every BTZTildeData (any T' satisfying the structure's fields) or only for the M̃ actually constructed (the chartwise T' of btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying_reg)? summary: Builds, with 1 real sorry (liftLocalData_sing), and no name clashes or DEC-33 violations. The abstract lifting theorem, the regular-sheet local data and the model limit facts are all proved with 0 sorry and are sound. The centres-as-labels argument is a real improvement on the dispatched finite-sheet lemma. _maximal is correctly certified by Manifolds' direct proof. The dispatch's headline, M GH ⇒ M̃ naturally GH, is not delivered: it rests on the tagged sorry. Proving it for the chartwise datum would close the non-vacuity existential, and SCOPE (c) says that is reachable but did not attempt it (major). _manifolds is marked closed even though its dispatch-defined closing condition, a natural-GH instance with BTZ points, is unmet (major, disclosed in REPORT's questions). Three minors: the sorry is tagged with a marked label, 'instances' is used for a conditional theorem, and the row's decl list is inflated.
